text:
tara: Quick follow-up from the Friday PM: the postmortem shows a recurring cache-thrash pattern. We need a tighter postmortem -> action tracker flow + clearer owners and a minor IC rotation tweak. Thoughts?

jonathan: +1. Can we standardize a short timeline template so PMs/ICs know deadlines? Something like:
```
T+0: incident reported / triage (IC)
T+1h: initial comms + incident thread update (IC)
T+24h: remediation owner assigned + temporary mitigations noted
T+72h: remediation plan + ETA (owner)
T+14d: deploy fix + verification (owner + verifier)
T+30d: follow-up check for regression (recurring-check owner)
```
This keeps follow-ups measurable.

alex: I like that. Suggestion: every postmortem gets 3 roles in the tracker: primary owner, verifier (different team if possible), and long-term recurring-check owner (on a 30d cadence). That prevents single-person blindspots.

maria: Also propose comms cadence additions: initial update within 1h, status every 4h until stable, and a final summary 24h after closure. For customer-facing incidents we should add a 48h external summary if customers were impacted.

jonathan: For recurring patterns, we should tag postmortems with pattern labels (e.g., cache-thrash, DB-connection, infra-deploy) and have a weekly job that checks for >1 occurrence in 30 days and surfaces to leadership + infra backlog. Could wire this into the postmortem tracker sheet as a new column and a simple alert rule.

sre-bot: Automated note: created issue #INC-6123 in infra-backlog for recurring pattern watchlist when tag_count > 1.

tara: Action items then: @jonathan will draft the timeline/template and example tracker columns by Wednesday EOD; @alex will draft the role matrix and an IC rotation cadence proposal (reduce consecutive IC shifts to 2 max) by Friday; @maria will update the comms section in the incident playbook and add external-summary guidance by Friday. I'll create the tracker sheet entry and set the weekly recurring-pattern sweep as a GH issue.

alex: FYI — for the rotation tweak, I recommend a 6-week pool with 2-week handoffs and a documented handover checklist. Less on-call fatigue + smoother context carry.

jonathan: I'll include a minimal spreadsheet template with columns: incident_ts, pm_link, primary_owner, verifier, recurring_label, remediation_eta, verification_date, followup_30d, status. Will add a sample row for Friday's incident.

maria: ack. I'll coordinate with comms for the external template and paste it into the playbook PR.

tara: OK — can everyone ack owners here so I can lock timelines?

jonathan: ack (jonathan) — template by Wed. :thumbsup:

alex: ack (alex) — role matrix + rotation by Fri. :thumbsup:

maria: ack (maria) — comms + external summary by Fri. :thumbsup:

tara: thanks. I'll post the tracker link when created and add a follow-up reminder for 30 days. If anyone spots other recurring labels to add, drop them in the spreadsheet.

sre-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up-check for INC-6123 in 30 days.
